data.name: RG_ROCK_01
data.value: The floor shudders at steady intervals.[pause=25] That's no rockfall.[pause=20] That's a rhythm.

data.name: RG_ROCK_02
data.value: It's coming from below,[pause=20] not the sides.[pause=25] And it's slowing...[pause=15] as if it were listening to us come.

data.name: RG_ROCK_03
data.value: (The rhythm has matched our steps.[pause=20] One beat for every two strides.)

data.name: RG_ROCK_04
data.value: STONE REMEMBERS EVERY STEP.[pause=25] YOURS ARE NEW.[pause=20] VERY NEW.[pause=30] SHOW ME THEY CARRY WEIGHT.

data.name: RG_ROCK_05
data.value: He heard us from the first floor...[pause=25] He simply waited for us to reach him.

data.name: RG_ROCK_06
data.value: FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-TWO.[pause=30] THAT IS HOW MANY ENTERED HERE BEFORE YOU.[pause=25] I COUNTED.

data.name: RG_ROCK_07
data.value: NONE LEFT BY THE FAR END.[pause=25] ALL WENT BACK THE WAY THEY CAME.[pause=30] BE THE FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-THIRD,[pause=20] OR BE THE FIRST.

data.name: RG_ROCK_08
data.value: The first,[pause=20] then.[pause=25] We didn't come all this way to turn back into a tally.

data.name: RG_ROCK_09
data.value: ...THE FIRST.[pause=30] I SHALL HAVE TO BEGIN MY COUNT AGAIN.[pause=25] THERE IS ONE THING I NEVER COUNTED, THOUGH.[pause=25] THE TIMES I LOOKED BEHIND ME.

data.name: RG_ROCK_10
data.value: Behind him...[pause=25] He wasn't watching the entrance.[pause=20] He was watching the back.

data.name: RG_ROCK_11
data.value: FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-THREE.[pause=30] THE COUNT HOLDS.[pause=25] COME BACK HEAVIER.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE
data.value: The guardian goes still.[pause=25] No crack,[pause=15] no collapse:[pause=20] it simply stands straighter than before,[pause=15] as if relieved of a weight.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE_P
data.value: Where it kept watch,[pause=20] the stone has split.[pause=25] Steps descend into the dark.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE
data.value: The floor gives way.[pause=25] The guardian doesn't pursue:[pause=15] it simply returns to its post,[pause=10] and waits.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE_P
data.value: We got thrown out...[pause=20] but it didn't finish us.[pause=25] It's waiting for us to come back ready.[pause=20] So let's go back.
